title: Duzy Space
description: Space World Gen for Servers, Customizable
body:
_The thumbnail sucks. Send me a message if you have a nicer one, and I'll use it instead!_
__________________________________________

DuzySpace is a world-generator plugin with:

- Customizable planets
- Random planets and asteroids
- Dependent on [Multiverse](https://modrinth.com/mod/multiverse-core) (or similiar) to actually generate a world with DuzySpace.

To generate a world with Multiverse, run this command:
```
mv create WORLD_NAME normal -g DuzySpace:default
```

To teleport to the world, run this command:

```
mv teleport WORLD_NAME
```

**Customization**

You can edit planet generation, spawn density, and lots of other things. To customize world generation for your world, add its name into worlds.yml. See comments in "plugins/DuzySpace/worlds.yml" and "plugins/DuzySpace/planets/defaultplanets.yml" for documentation.
